name: brazil-vat
description: Use this Guide for a Brazilian company or business reviewing calendar-2026 federal consumption taxes, PIS/Pasep, Cofins, imported services and the phased CBS/IBS reform. It establishes cumulative versus noncumulative treatment, statutory output and credit bases, exclusion of ICMS and the current ISS judgment, electronic-document phases, conditional test-year payment waiver and actual-payment offsets. It includes supplier and bank reconciliation patterns, ordinary compliance routes and worked cases, while identifying concrete local or specialised facts still needed. Trigger phrases include Brazilian VAT, PIS, Cofins, CBS, IBS, Imposto Seletivo, nota fiscal, imported SaaS, EFD-Contribuições and consumption tax reform. Load br-indirect-tax for ICMS/ISS/IPI computation and br-simples-nacional for annexes, thresholds, DAS and the Simples election.
